subtitle: Gcwalisa amathemomitha
short_description: Gcwalisa amathubhu usuka ebhalbhu, amasamba emigqa nekholomu alingane.
description:
Gcwalisa ithubhu ngayinye kwamathubhu angu-8 aneziseli ezimbili kusuka ebhalbhwini uye ethiphini, hhayi ngendlela ehlukile. Amasamba emigqa nekholomu akhombisa ukuthi amaseli angaki agcwele kulowo mugqa noma kulelo kholomu.

Thepha ibhalbhu ukuze ugcwalise isegimenti yokuqala, noma uthepha ithiphu ukuze ugcwalise zombili. Thepha indawo efanayo futhi ukuze ukhiphe ithubhu.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
